feedback_use: Retains the accepted parent’s native sampled-pair objective, annealed graph relaxation, and area-centered geometry. It adds only bounded node-timing modulation to the graph term, motivated by the parent’s consistent ariane133 gains but mixed bp_fe seed results.
hypothesis: Moderately emphasizing graph edges adjacent to covered nodes with poor normalized worst and mean slack should better preserve prototype-critical neighborhoods for both WNS and TNS, while bounded weighting and annealing limit overfitting to fixed 2D timing.
